summary: Users can assign a resolution status to error groups to help triage errors.
extended_definition: Users can assign a resolution status to error groups to help triage errors.

supporting_pages.title: Manage error groups \_|\_ Error Reporting \_|\_ Google Cloud Documentation
evidence_snippets: Change resolution status To record the status of your investigation into an error group, do the following: In the Google Cloud console, go to the Error Reporting page: Go to Error Reporting You can also find this page by using the search bar.
If you subscribe to notifications for the Google Cloud project and delete error events for an error group that has a status of Resolved , then the error group resolution status changes back to Open .
Add links to error groups You can link error groups to pages such as issue trackers or documentation with resolution steps.
